issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 抓成 66f，改版前视频在字母还歪着时就结束，帧 110 的集体回正一拍根本没演到
字母只是刚体平移：下落没有拉伸、触地没有挤压、空中没有运动模糊，看起来像贴纸在滑，不像有重量的东西砸下来
地面是一根 6px 灰条，字母和地面之间没有任何接触影，落地没有落到实处
字符塞进 150px 等宽槽位，I 两侧空一大块、W 型字挤在一起，字距忽松忽紧；字体回退成 Helvetica
起跳间隔 i×5 等差，回正一拍从 1 直接跳到 1.06，有一帧突变
changes: 导出 LETTER_DROP_PHYSICS_DURATION = 150（帧 110 回正，116–150 真静止 34f）
下落按速度纵向拉伸（最多 10%），三次触地各给一次阻尼挤压（强度 1 / 0.45 / 0.18，保体积反向撑宽），下落段加速度驱动的竖向 SpeedBlur
每个字脚下加接触影：离地越高越大越虚越淡，落地收成小而实的一抹；歪着站时按歪角把字抬起，底角贴地不穿地面
字行改为 SF Pro 800 按自然字宽 flex 排版（运动全走 transform），起跳帧改成 4+36·(1−(1−i/6)^1.5)，间隔 8.6→2.5f 越来越密
回正一拍先 2f 吸气撑到 1.06，再 6f snappy 回 1，歪角用 overshoot 回正；随后浮出 36px 副标题作句号
背景换成柔光渐变 + 地平线发丝线 + 向下渐淡的台面，叠 0.05 颗粒
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench took 66f from the md, so the before video ends while the letters are still tilted and never reaches the frame-110 snap to attention
Letters moved as rigid sprites: no stretch while falling, no squash on impact, no motion blur in the air, so they slid like stickers instead of landing with weight
The floor was a 6px gray bar with no contact shadows, so nothing actually touched the ground
Characters sat in fixed 150px slots, leaving gaps around the I while wide letters crowded each other; the font fell back to Helvetica
Drop starts were evenly spaced at i×5, and the snap jumped from scale 1 to 1.06 in a single frame
changesEn: Exported LETTER_DROP_PHYSICS_DURATION = 150 (snap at frame 110, true stillness for the final 34f, 116–150)

Letters stretch vertically with fall speed (up to 10%), each of the three impacts gets a damped, volume-preserving squash (strength 1 / 0.45 / 0.18), and the fall uses a velocity-driven vertical SpeedBlur

Each letter casts a contact shadow that grows larger, softer and fainter with height and tightens to a small dense patch on landing; tilted letters are raised by their tilt so the lower corner rests on the floor instead of sinking into it
The word is now set in SF Pro 800 at natural advance widths (all motion through transforms), and drop starts follow 4+36·(1−(1−i/6)^1.5), so gaps tighten from 8.6f to 2.5f
The snap is now a 2f inhale to 1.06 followed by a 6f snappy return to 1, with tilt straightening on an overshoot curve; a 36px subtitle then fades up as the full stop
The background is now a soft-lit gradient with a hairline horizon and a floor plane that fades downward, plus 0.05 grain
